name: Twilight Domain
summary: Guardians of the night who keep watch against the dark.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.short: Darkvision 300 ft.; share it with allies.
features.summary: You have darkvision out to 300 ft. As an action, you can share it with willing creatures within 10 ft. for 1 hour (once per long rest, or by spending a spell slot).

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.short: Give a creature advantage on its next initiative roll.
features.summary: As an action, you give one creature you touch advantage on its next initiative roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.short: A 30 ft. sphere that grants temp HP or ends charm/fear.
features.summary: As an action, create a 30 ft. sphere of twilight centered on you for 1 minute. Whenever a creature ends its turn in it, you can give it 1d6 + your cleric level temporary hit points or end a charmed or frightened effect on it.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.short: Bonus action: fly in dim light or darkness for a minute.
features.summary: As a bonus action while in dim light or darkness, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 radiant (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.short: Your sanctuary also gives half cover.
features.summary: You and your allies have half cover while in your Twilight Sanctuary sphere.
